Quick summary

The global 3D wayfinding software market is forecast to expand significantly from 2026 to 2033, driven by demand from retail, healthcare, transportation, and smart city sectors.

Key takeaways

  • Key players include Google, Apple, HERE Technologies, Mapbox, Pointr, Navigine, IndoorAtlas, and ARUP
  • Segments span retail, healthcare, hospitality, transportation, education, smart cities, and events
  • North America leads adoption, followed by Europe and Asia-Pacific
  • AI integration and IoT connectivity are key growth drivers
  • Smart city initiatives are accelerating deployment of 3D wayfinding solutions
